title: AnimationTreeStateMachine transitions continually check advance_expression even if switch_mode is set 'at_end'
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in:
- `4.0` (Has slightly different behavior mentioned in the MRP)
- `4.1` (Shows the same behavior as `4.6`)
- `4.6`
- `4.7.dev3` (latest at the time of post)

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Freedesktop SDK 24.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.25 GiB memory

### Issue description

`AnimationTreeStateMachine` animation nodes that have transitions with an `advance_expression` set will always be checked, even if the transition itself is set to `at_end`. This is to say that it seems like the engine checks `switch_mode` _after_ checking the `advance_expression`, because if the expression is always `true`, the animation will only actually transition once it reaches the end (as expected).

This on its own is rather harmless if the expressions are just used to simply check for booleans, but not only could it be a minor performance concern if the expression calls a _heavier_ method, but also means that methods that execute _logic_ will be constantly called, rather than at the animation's end.

So for example: you try to set a character state **only** when you exit an specific animation node, and you set this state by calling a method (that always returns `true`) in a transition which has `at_end` set, you'd expect it to be called once, maybe twice, right at the animation's end, but currently it will instead be called _every frame_ that transition is accessible.

### Steps to reproduce

While an MRP is given, this can easily be reproduced in any project by setting an `advance_expression` in a transition that calls code (such as a `print` function - making sure it always returns true so the transition actually works) while said transition's `switch_mode` is set `at_end`, then either play the project or let the `AnimationTree` play in editor.

In the MRP, opening the project will open the main scene with the `AnimationTree` likely already playing, said tree will proceed to spam the main log due to calling the expression set in the animation's transition, despite said transition supposedly only activating at the animation's end, once the animation ends, it does transition to the next before changing back instantly as the other node's transition is `immediate`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_2026-04-09_14-43-10.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26603411/test_2026-04-09_14-43-10.zip)
MRP contains the following:
- An AnimationPlayer that has a generic "default" animation that lasts 1 second.
- An AnimationTree that contains a StateMachine as its root, which contains two nodes (both playing "default") - this setup also triggers the unrelated bug issued here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91639#issue-2281905964

The two StateMachine nodes transition to each other, but the left→right transition has `at_end` set, with the `advance_expression` set to `printerr("Transition at end, but is called every frame") == null` always returns `true` due to how expressions work; while the other transition is `immediate`, with the expression set to `print("Return instantly as it is an immediate call") == null` also returns `true`, but is called twice _(once in 4.0)_ before transitioning.
